subject: Case study & logo usage approval — Vanguard Health

Subject: Request: case study & logo use approval

Hi Mina,

Thanks again for the conversation last week — the team at Vanguard Health is excited about the results from the pilot. We put together a short draft case study and a pull-quote we hoped you could review and approve for use on Redwood’s website and partner materials.

Attached: Vanguard-draft-case-study-v1.docx (draft narrative + suggested quote)

Quick asks:
- Can Redwood confirm permission to use Vanguard Health name and logo in a customer case study?
- Approve the quoted language (we flagged the section under “Results / Quote”).
- Any brand usage restrictions we should follow?

If easier, we can hop on a quick 20-minute call to go over edits.

Best,
Sarah Lang

sarah.lang@vanguardhealth.com

Hi Sarah — thanks for sending this over and congrats to your team on the strong pilot results.

We’d love to publish a Vanguard Health case study. I’ve attached a short excerpt we plan to use on the site and the hero quote pulled from the draft (excerpt-for-approval.txt).

Next steps from our side:
- Internal quick review (legal + comms). I’ve looped in Monica (PR & comms) and Aditya (account lead) to confirm logo usage and exact quote wording.
- If that looks good, we’ll send a formal approval letter for signature and a DocuSign for the logo/quote permission.

Can you confirm the preferred Vanguard logo file (full-color vs. monochrome) and any brand guidelines PDF? If you already have a short legal contact we should send the final approval to, please include them.

Thanks — I’ll follow up with our approved copy within 48 hours.

— Mina Haddad
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
mina_haddad@redwood.ai | (650) 555-0199
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 09:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Request: case study & logo use approval

Mina / Aditya — quick notes from comms review: we like the narrative; two small asks before we send to legal and to Vanguard for signature.

1) Edit the quote to remove the specific savings percentage (legal prefers ranges unless customer confirms a published number). Suggest replacing "we reduced inference cost by 37%" with "we significantly reduced inference cost".
2) Add a short attribution line for the logo use (e.g., "Vanguard Health, used with permission").

I’ve attached a redline with suggested wording (redlines.pdf). If Aditya can confirm that Vanguard is okay with the number being generalized, we’ll run this with legal and produce the final approval letter.

Also: confirm whether Vanguard wants us to host the full logo file or they prefer to supply a high-res asset.

— Monica Patel
Head of Communications, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Subject: Final approval & next steps — Vanguard Health case study

Hi Sarah / Tom — quick update and thank you.

We completed an internal comms + legal check. Legal prefers that we generalize the specific percentage in the quoted language; Monaco suggested the same. Aditya confirmed with your account team that Vanguard is comfortable with the generalized phrasing.

Summary of approved items:
- Redwood may publish the case study using Vanguard Health name and logo.
- Final approved quotation: "Vanguard Health saw significant cost reductions and faster model iteration after deploying Redwood’s dedicated inference environment."
- Brand use: please confirm which logo file you prefer (full-color PNG or monochrome SVG). We will include the attribution line: "Vanguard Health — used with permission."
- Attached is our approval letter for signature (redwood-approval-letter.pdf). We’ll send a DocuSign once you confirm the logo asset.

Attachments: redwood-approval-letter.pdf (approval letter for signature)
DocuSign: https://app.docusign.com/templates/ABC123-Vanguard
Drive (draft + final assets): https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2bVanguardDraft

If you’re good with the above, please reply with: 1) preferred logo file and 2) signatory name/email for DocuSign. We can publish after returned signature and final asset delivery.

Thanks again — excited to share Vanguard’s story.
